fields.label: Component
fields.description: A catalog key, for example bar_chart, or a layout primitive.

fields.label: Columns
fields.description: Grid span, 1 to 12. Ignored by section_break and spacer, which are always full width.

fields.label: Config (JSON)
fields.description: The component's options. Must match the component options schema.

fields.label: Frozen Data (JSON)
fields.description: The baked data the component renders. Must match the component's data_template. Data is saved with the page.

fields.label: Data Script
fields.description: Run this script on opening and manual refresh instead of using Frozen Data.

fields.label: Script Parameters (JSON)
fields.description: An object passed to the script as args.
